doc: The venture's registered experiments (ROADMAP B142, plan 55 § 5.6, VISION § Decided 'Autonomous acquisition' #12). Read by lib/experiments.py; `outreach status --by experiment ID` and `leads week --by experiment ID` count them, and nothing that isn't here is read as a result. One dimension varied per population; never crossed; the sequencing doctrine: a later experiment varies something only after an earlier one's primary endpoint (its `entry` stage is at or past it). `fields` says where the rows write a business's arm: `experiment` (that field equals the id) or `member` (that field is set), and `arm`. E1's fields and E3's are named differently on purpose: a reply row carries E3's `experiment_id`/`arm` beside the send's `proposition_experiment`/`proposition_arm`. A new experiment is added here on its owner's word, after one closes (the Sunday review may propose it).

E1.name: the frame
E1.population: the P5 pool (own site, no fault found)
E1.deal: sha256('E1:' + place_id), first 8 hex digits, mod 2: 0 is P5, 1 is P6
E1.held_at_default: the AI sentence beside the introduction; the close arm as E3 assigns
E1.kill_rule: an arm with 200 delivered and a positive-reply rate under half the other's is paused

E2.name: the AI line
E2.population: the chore lanes (P1, P3, P4) while the AI-line test is open
E2.varied: where the AI disclosure sentence sits in the letter
E2.deal: by sha256(place_id) within each fault key, carried across batches (B132)
E2.held_at_default: the proposition each business's facts fit (observational, not dealt)
E2.kill_rule: B132's own: none; the test stops when Taylor says, never by itself
E2.status: built; starts on Taylor's `outreach ai-test start`
E2.note: three arms as Taylor approved them (plan 55 § 5.6 recommends two, intro vs none; his call, § 9 #5)

E3.name: the close
E3.population: interested replies to batch letters, any lane
E3.deal: by place, when the reply is classed interested and arm B can be served (B137)
E3.kill_rule: none: the long game; reported from day one, decided when a cell passes 50 interested
E3.status: open when arm B can be served (`outreach status --by arm` says)
